# ANALYSIS: J-days validation baseline

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to measure the engine's edge capture on J's source-of-truth trade days to see if it meets the OP-16 floor of 771, and to check for overfit via walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days.

## Mechanism

Run Stage-1 backtest (in-sample) on the full history, compute engine P&L on the three winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and three loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07 x2), then compute edge_capture per OP-16. Perform walk-forward OOS test on a held-out window (e.g., last 20% of timeline) to check for overfit. Validate real-fills on the top 3 J days using realistic OPRA simulation (cached bid/ask, slippage model) and compare to BS-sim results.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** $25K+ required for qty=28 (as per OP-20). For $1K paper, ~14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** Using all available data up to 2026-06-18; selection method is fixed J days; overfit risk high if not validated OOS.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated with realistic simulator).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a loser day where engine takes large loss; max drawdown scenario; blow-up if engine takes all three losers full size.
6. **Concentration:** If top 5 days = X% of P&L, unknown until backtest.

## Pre-merge gate

Stage-1 backtest must pass, walk-forward OOS must show ratio >=0.70, real-fills validation must show <20% diff from BS sim.
